$comment: Template: ${PUBLIC_ORIGIN} is substituted at render time. Produce a submittable manifest with `python scripts/render_manifests.py --env prod` (or --env dev), or fetch the rendered document from a running server at GET /manifests/gemini_extension.json, which fills in the origin it was reached on.
name: financial-portfolios-ai
description: Google Vertex AI & Gemini Extension for quantitative model portfolios, target asset allocations, and model alignment arithmetic from Financial Portfolios AI. Informational only under publisher exclusion.

tools.name: list_portfolios
tools.description: List every active quantitative investment portfolio, each marked access = subscribed or public_delayed.

tools.name: get_portfolio_allocation
tools.description: Retrieve a target allocation snapshot: latest book for subscribed portfolios, otherwise the public book delayed ~45 days.

tools.name: get_portfolio_history
tools.description: Retrieve historical allocation snapshots; non-subscribers receive only delayed entries (~45 days).

tools.name: rebalance_portfolio
tools.description: Calculate mathematical model alignment arithmetic (share quantity differences) for user holdings. Requires an active subscription.

tools.name: get_rebalance_template
tools.description: Download holdings CSV template (max 200 rows, 512 KB).

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: Search and list published quantitative research articles.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Retrieve full content of a research article.

tools.name: get_token_info
tools.description: Check API token metadata and active subscription status.
